To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the alpha-2 adrenoreceptor agonists 2,6-Dimethyl clonidin (2,6-DIC) and clonidine have opposite effects on the renal excretion of water and sodium.

1) 2,6-Dimethyl clonidin (2,6-DMC) increased urine flow in the rat independent of vasopresin, 2) 2, 6-DMC increased solute excretion and this effect was independent of vasopression, 3) Clonidine increased free water clearance and its effect was dependent on vasopressin

2,6-DIC increases water and solute delivery into the proximal tubule and increases solute excretion, whereas clonidine increases free water clearance, an effect that is mediated through an action on the renal actions of V2 vasopressin receptors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of the renal actions of alpha-2 agonists and their interaction with vasopressin and the renin-angiotensin system.
the effects of alpha-2 agonists on renal function.
the identification of the sites of action of alpha-2 agonists and the mechanisms involved.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the rank order of potency of alpha-2 agonists for water and solute clearance is opposite and that 2,6-DMC may act at a different site from clonidine.
the alpha-2 adrenoreceptor agonists, UK 14-304, clonidine and 2, 6-DMC produce different effects in the kidney.
2,6 dimethyl clonidine is a selective alpha 2 adrenoceptor antagonist in the kidney and that the alpha 2 adrenergic receptors are heterogeneous in the kidney.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the alpha-2 adrenergic receptors are not a homogeneous population.
2,6 dimethyl clonidine is a unique alpha-2 adrenergic agonist which has a different mechanism of action than clonidine and UK 14,303 in the renal vasculature and in the proximal tubule.
2,6-DIC increases solute excretion by a direct action on proximal tubular function and that clonidine increases free water excretion through its actions on the renal actions of arginine-vasopressine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
2,6-Dimethyl clonidin is a potent alpha-2 agonist with a very different profile than the classic alpha-2 agonists, such as clonidine and UK 14, 304.
2,6-DIC is not a selective α2A receptor agonist, but rather a mixed α2A/α2B receptor agonist.
the effects of alpha-2 agonists on water excretion are complex.
